analysis: The trial timed out after 2,234.02 allocated GPU-seconds. The host returned no validation score, so improvement over the reference HR@10=0.5800 is unknown. No logs identify the stopping category, completed epochs, or whether diagnostics passed. Candidate-conditioned scoring across 256 negatives, small scoring chunks, checkpoint recomputation, and repeated backward calls plausibly increased runtime, but the timeout cause is unconfirmed. The 2,400-second category limit is checked only after each epoch and does not guarantee completion within the host timeout. Future experiments should reduce scoring overhead and enforce a total runtime budget while preserving the single-model constraint.
code_summary: One independently trained bidirectional MaskedSASRec per category, with tied item embeddings and jointly learned item bias. Each candidate conditions an attention query over encoded corrupted history; padding-masked pooled context and the supervised-position feature pass through a shared projection and LayerNorm before an unnormalized tied-embedding dot product. Training retains masked reconstruction, 256 shared uniform negatives, target-collision masking, and equal final/auxiliary loss weighting. Chunked, checkpointed scoring accumulates feature gradients before one encoder backward pass. Validation selects one checkpoint per category using HR@10 with NDCG tie-breaking. The predictor writer reconstructs this architecture and strictly loads that category’s single selected checkpoint. Diagnostic and predictor-parity checks are included, but their completion is unverified.
